UCity.description: unadjusted city MPG for fuelType1; see the description of the EPA test procedures

UCityA.description: unadjusted city MPG for fuelType2; see the description of the EPA test procedures

UHighway.description: unadjusted highway MPG for fuelType1; see the description of the EPA test procedures

UHighwayA.description: unadjusted highway MPG for fuelType2; see the description of the EPA test procedures

atvType.description: type of alternative fuel or advanced technology vehicle

barrels08.description: annual petroleum consumption in barrels for fuelType1 (1)

barrelsA08.description: annual petroleum consumption in barrels for fuelType2 (1)

battery.description: Battery-related source field. Its exact meaning and encoding are absent from the captured guide; retained without interpretation and excluded from inputs.

charge120.description: time to charge an electric vehicle in hours at 120 V

charge240.description: time to charge an electric vehicle in hours at 240 V

charge240b.description: time to charge an electric vehicle in hours at 240 V using the alternate charger

cityCD.description: city gasoline consumption (gallons/100 miles) in charge depleting mode (4)

cityE.description: city electricity consumption in kWh/100 miles

cityMpk.description: city miles per kilogram for hydrogen

cityUF.description: EPA city utility factor (share of electricity) for PHEV

cityUmpk.description: unrounded city miles per kilogram for hydrogen

co2.description: tailpipe CO2 in grams/mile for fuelType1 (5)

co2A.description: tailpipe CO2 in grams/mile for fuelType2 (5)

co2TailpipeAGpm.description: tailpipe CO2 in grams/mile for fuelType2 (5)

co2TailpipeGpm.description: tailpipe CO2 in grams/mile for fuelType1 (5)

combE.description: combined electricity consumption in kWh/100 miles

combMpk.description: combined miles per kilogram for hydrogen

combUmpk.description: unrounded combined miles per kilogram for hydrogen

combinedCD.description: combined gasoline consumption (gallons/100 miles) in charge depleting mode (4)

combinedUF.description: EPA combined utility factor (share of electricity) for PHEV

createdOn.description: date the vehicle record was created

cylDeact.description: Cylinder-deactivation source code inferred from the field name; exact code mapping is not documented in the captured API guide.

cylDeactYesNo.description: Human-readable cylinder-deactivation indicator inferred from the field name; not used for eligibility or prediction.

emissionsList.description: Nested emissions records linked to this vehicle; see the emissions section of the API guide.

evMotor.description: Electric-motor source description. The guide labels it as kW, but actual responses can contain free-form power, voltage and battery text; preserve it as a string.

feScore.description: EPA Fuel Economy Score (-1 = Not available)

fuelType.description: fuel type with fuelType1 and fuelType2 (if applicable)

fuelType1.description: fuel type 1. For single fuel vehicles, this will be the only fuel. For dual fuel vehicles, this will be the conventional fuel.

fuelType2.description: fuel type 2. For dual fuel vehicles, this will be the alternative fuel (e.g., E85, Electricity, CNG, LPG). For single fuel vehicles, this field is not used

ghgScoreA.description: EPA GHG score for dual fuel vehicle running on the alternative fuel (-1 = Not available)

guzzler.description: if G or T, this vehicle is subject to the gas guzzler tax

highwayCD.description: highway gasoline consumption (gallons/100 miles) in charge depleting mode (4)

highwayE.description: highway electricity consumption in kWh/100 miles

highwayMpk.description: highway miles per kilogram for hydrogen

highwayUF.description: EPA highway utility factor (share of electricity) for PHEV

highwayUmpk.description: unrounded highway miles per kilogram for hydrogen

modifiedOn.description: date the vehicle record was last modified

mpgData.description: has My MPG data; see yourMpgVehicle and yourMpgDriverVehicle

mpgRevised.description: Source flag apparently indicating revised MPG estimates; exact field encoding is absent from the captured guide. Not a predictor.

phevBlended.description: if true, this vehicle operates on a blend of gasoline and electricity in charge depleting mode

phevCity.description: EPA composite gasoline-electricity city MPGe for plug-in hybrid vehicles

phevComb.description: EPA composite gasoline-electricity combined city-highway MPGe for plug-in hybrid vehicles

phevHwy.description: EPA composite gasoline-electricity highway MPGe for plug-in hybrid vehicles

range.description: Driving-range source field for the primary fuel. Exact encoding and units are not defined for this key in the captured API guide; excluded from inputs.

rangeCity.description: City driving-range source field for the primary fuel. Exact encoding and units are not defined for this key in the captured guide; excluded from inputs.

rangeHwy.description: Highway driving-range source field for the primary fuel. Exact encoding and units are not defined for this key in the captured guide; excluded from inputs.

sCharger.description: if S, this vehicle is supercharged

startStop.description: vehicle has stop-start technology (Y, N, or blank for older vehicles)

tCharger.description: if T, this vehicle is turbocharged

youSaveSpend.description: you save/spend over 5 years compared to an average car ($). Savings are positive; a greater amount spent yields a negative number. For dual fuel vehicles, this is the cost savings for gasoline
